library(dplyr)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Plot function - Median of ratios counts
- Some info [https://hbctraining.github.io/DGE_workshop/lessons/02_DGE_count_normalization.html]
- DESeq2’s median of ratios for comparison of genes BETWEEN samples (https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/DESeq2/versions/1.12.3/topics/estimateSizeFactors)
- Adjusts for differences in sequencing depth (library size) - important when comparing gene expression BETWEEN samples
----------------------------------------------------------------------

FUNCTION: Plot median of ratios normalized counts
```{r}
plot_NormCounts <- function (data, metadata, genes, prot_name){
  
  data_long <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -X, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
    filter(X %in% genes) %>%
    filter(short_name %in% c(paste0("Expi_", prot_name), paste0("Vulko_", prot_name))) %>%
    dplyr::select(X, cell_type, case, expression)
  
  summary_stats <- data_long %>%
    group_by(X, cell_type) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_expression = mean(expression),
      sd_expression = sd(expression),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  
  ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = X, y = mean_expression, fill = cell_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expression - sd_expression, ymax = mean_expression + sd_expression),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Counts (median of ratios norm)", title=paste0("Gene count in ", prot_name, " producers"), fill = "Cell line") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Expi" = "#9bd1ae", "Vulko" = "#98b5eb")) +
    ylim(0, 3000000) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16)
      )
}
```


FUNCTION: Plot TPMs function
```{r}
plot_tpms <- function (tpms, metadata, genes, prot_name){
  
  tpms_long <- tpms %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -X, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
    filter(X %in% genes) %>%
    filter(short_name %in% c(paste0("Expi_", prot_name), paste0("Vulko_", prot_name))) %>%
    dplyr::select(X, cell_type, case, expression)
  
  summary_stats <- tpms_long %>%
    group_by(X, cell_type) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_expression = mean(expression),
      sd_expression = sd(expression),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = X, y = mean_expression, fill = cell_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expression - sd_expression, ymax = mean_expression + sd_expression),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
    labs(x = "", y = "TPM", title=paste0("TPMs in ", prot_name, " producers"), fill = "Cell line") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Expi" = "#9bd1ae", "Vulko" = "#98b5eb")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16)
      )
}
```


----------------------------------------------------------------------
Plot gene counts
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Median of ratios normalized
```{r}
# Input data
metadata <- read.table("../meta/metadata.txt", header = TRUE)
estfact <- read.csv("../results/DE/estFactors_normalized_counts.csv")

height = 5
width = 4

############################################################################################################

pdf("../results/count_plots/med_of_ratios/GPR75.pdf", width = width, height = height) 
plot_NormCounts(estfact, metadata, c("GPR75_addon"), "GPR75") # GPR75_tpm.pdf
dev.off()

pdf("../results/count_plots/med_of_ratios/ULK1_GPR75.pdf", width = width, height = height) 
plot_NormCounts(estfact, metadata, c("ULK1"), "GPR75") # ULK1_GPR75.pdf
dev.off()

############################################################################################################

pdf("../results/count_plots/med_of_ratios/GIPR.pdf", width = width, height = height) 
plot_NormCounts(estfact, metadata, c("GIPR_addon"), "GIPR") # GIPR.pdf
dev.off()

pdf("../results/count_plots/med_of_ratios/ULK1_GIPR.pdf", width = width, height = height) 
plot_NormCounts(estfact, metadata, c("ULK1"), "GIPR") # ULK1_GIPR.pdf
dev.off()

############################################################################################################

pdf("../results/count_plots/med_of_ratios/hP2X3.pdf", width = width, height = height) 
plot_NormCounts(estfact, metadata, c("hP2X3_addon"), "hP2X3") # hP2X3.pdf
dev.off()

pdf("../results/count_plots/med_of_ratios/ULK1_hP2X3.pdf", width = width, height = height) 
plot_NormCounts(estfact, metadata, c("ULK1"), "hP2X3") # ULK1_hP2X3.pdf
dev.off()

```
